Hi Dean,

Thanks for sending the link. Our Hammer Miner DC08 (480 MH/s, ~137 W on our listing) is $539.00, and pricing isn't something I can change on my side, so I've passed your request straight to Georges. He handles anything on price and will come back to you on this thread, tomorrow from 10am ET.

If it helps while you wait, the DC08 is in stock with us and ships with the plug matched to your address. There's also the Doge Duo Pack, the DC06 plus the DC08 together at $799.99, if you were thinking about adding Scrypt hashrate anyway: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-scrypt-pack-dc06-plus-dc08

Glad to hear Harlo OS is treating you well. The latest builds and release notes are always at https://harlolabs.com/ if you want to stay current.

Wow, that was a quick reply.

I had came across a few discount codes: THANKS-10, LABORWEEK10, OFF10, and SAVE30. I tried THANKS-10 and LABORWEEK10, but neither worked at checkout.
Could you let me know whether any of these codes are currently valid, and whether there are any active discounts for the DC08? I saw that LABORWEEK10 was described as a Labor Week offer, so I’d also appreciate knowing whether that promotion has ended.
Dean

Hi Dean,

Glad it got to you quickly.

On the codes: if a code is rejected at checkout, it is not active, so THANKS-10 and LABORWEEK10 are both expired. LABORWEEK10 was indeed a Labor Week promotion and that one has ended. I would expect the same for OFF10 and SAVE30, and I would rather tell you that straight than have you keep trying them.

There is no active discount on the DC08 right now. The price on our listing is $539.00, which is what checkout will charge, plus shipping and any sales tax for your address.

Your price match question is already with Georges and he picks it up tomorrow from 10am ET, with the answer coming back to you in this thread.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
